Furthermore, we estimated risk ratios for: • development of active TB among household contacts with LTBI and • cumulative prevalence of active TB irrespective of baseline LTBI status, by age stratum, with children aged < 5 years as the reference. The cumulative prevalence of active TB includes cases diagnosed during contact investigations at baseline and incident cases that developed thereafter.
